content: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 card (primary): ~0.6B params fine-tuned from bge-m3, multilingual, Apache-2.0; usage via sentence-transformers CrossEncoder.predict, FlagReranker(normalize=True sigmoid), or AutoModelForSequenceClassification logits; card example max_length=512 (SIF CrossEncoderReranker also hardcodes 512). Card does not claim gains over strong first stages; localGPT measured it HURT (-0.022/-0.058 nDCG) when first stage was strong. Score distribution differs from Qwen3 yes/no probs => SIF relative threshold alpha=0.5 not transferable.
